mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(user_id, username, role_codes, action, object_type, object_id, result, before_value, after_value, ip_address, trace_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{username}, #{roleCodes}, #{action}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{result}, CAST(#{beforeValue} AS JSON), CAST(#{afterValue} AS JSON), #{ipAddress}, #{traceId})
